title: Two paragraphs in one story
concept:
A ParagraphStyleRange is a style run, not a paragraph: the
character ends a paragraph, so two paragraphs can share one range.

annotations.note: One ParagraphStyleRange: a run of text sharing the same paragraph attributes. It holds both paragraphs.
is the paragraph mark. Every paragraph except the story's last ends with one; this is where the first paragraph ends.

The second paragraph is the story's last, so it carries no mark. A paragraph with different attributes would start a new ParagraphStyleRange, and the one before it would still end with
.
